hints.title: Retain All Members
hints.text: Retain every member in the report by combining member records with visits and purchases using outer joins.

hints.title: Group and Count
hints.text: Group rows by member to aggregate total visits and completed purchase interactions.

hints.title: Conversion Classification
hints.text: Use conditional expressions to evaluate conversion rates and assign tier categories.

hints.title: Complete Query
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.name,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(v.visit_id) = 0 THEN 'Bronze'
        WHEN 100.0 * COUNT(p.visit_id) / COUNT(v.visit_id) >= 80 THEN 'Diamond'
        WHEN 100.0 * COUNT(p.visit_id) / COUNT(v.visit_id) >= 50 THEN 'Gold'
        ELSE 'Silver'
    END AS category
FROM Members m
LEFT JOIN Visits v ON m.member_id = v.member_id
LEFT JOIN Purchases p ON v.visit_id = p.visit_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.name;
```

complexity.time: O(M + V + P) scanning members, visits, and purchases
complexity.space: O(M) result set rows for all members
complexity.notes: Left joins preserve members with zero visits for bronze tier designation.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Inner joins drop members who never visited the store, omitting bronze tier members.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Outer join grouping calculates conversion rates in a single aggregation step.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should handle division by zero and correctly prioritize bronze tier.
